fields.description: The opaque docname series. Neither the person nor the event goes in the primary key, so nobody can walk the register by guessing what somebody else is going to.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Who said they are going. The Red Profile rather than the login, because a person is one profile across every app the society runs, and because a member enrolled from paper who later makes an account is still the same person who said yes.
fields.label: Red Profile

fields.description: Which event, held as the identifier the events app gave it. Plain data rather than a Link, because the events app is not required by this one: a site without it would have a broken field on every row, and this record is a statement of intent that outlives whether the listing is installed.
fields.label: Event

fields.description: Whether the intention still stands. Withdrawing sets this to Cancelled rather than deleting the row, so a coordinator who counted on somebody can see that the answer changed instead of finding that it was never given.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the current answer was given. Rewritten each time the answer changes, so it reads as the date of the standing intention rather than the date the row first appeared.
fields.label: Responded On
